verdict.rationale: Dagster's own documentation covers recurring scheduling of jobs. Schedules run jobs at hourly, daily or weekly intervals or on cron expressions, and Declarative Automation's on_cron condition runs assets on each cron tick once upstream dependencies have updated. The daemon container in deployments supports this long-running scheduling. Missing for 10: independent hands-on or community corroboration of scheduling specifically.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Schedules enable automated execution of jobs at specified intervals. These intervals can range from common frequencies like hourly, daily, or weekly, to more complex patterns defined using cron expressions.
The AutomationCondition.on_cron will execute an asset once per cron schedule tick, after all upstream dependencies have updated.
